**إلى: فريق عمل Qahwa Lab**
**من: سارة القحطاني، مديرة التسويق**
**الموضوع: استراتيجية حملة رمضان - Qahwa Lab**

---

### **1. Core Messaging / الرسائل الأساسية**

*   **English:** "Elevate your Ramadan nights. From the first sip after Iftar to the quiet moments before Suhoor, our Ramadan Blend is crafted to be the heart of your gatherings. Proudly roasted in Riyadh for the modern Saudi home."
*   **العربية:** "ارتقِ بأمسياتك الرمضانية. من الرشفة الأولى بعد الإفطار وحتى لحظات السحور الهادئة، صُمم مزيجنا الرمضاني ليكون قلب جمعاتكم. محمص بكل فخر في الرياض، ليليق بذائقة البيت السعودي العصري."

---

### **2. Offer Structure / هيكل العرض**

*   **The Offer:** 20% discount on "Ramadan Blend" beans + Free delivery for orders placed between 6:00 PM and 3:00 AM.
*   **Mechanism:** Use code **RAMADAN20** at checkout.
*   **Goal:** Drive online bean sales and increase post-Iftar traffic (assumption).

---

### **3. Channel Strategy & Timeline / استراتيجية القنوات والجدول الزمني**

**Budget Allocation (40,000 SAR):**
*   **Social Media Ads (Snapchat/Instagram):** 25,000 SAR
*   **Influencer Partnerships (Local Riyadh Foodies):** 10,000 SAR
*   **Email & Landing Page Production:** 5,000 SAR

**Timeline:**
*   **Nov 1–15:** Content production (Omar Haddad to finalize visuals).
*   **Nov 16–19:** Landing page testing and email sequence setup.
*   **Nov 20:** Campaign Launch (Landing page live, Email #1 sent).
*   **Nov 20 – Dec 4:** Two-week social media push.

---

### **4. Execution Plan / خطة التنفيذ**

| Channel | Activity | Frequency |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Landing Page** | Dedicated page for Ramadan Blend with "Buy Now" CTA. | Permanent (Launch Nov 20) |
| **Email Sequence** | 1. Launch announcement, 2. "Perfect Brew" guide, 3. Last call. | 3 emails total |
| **Social Media** | Instagram Reels/Snapchat Ads focusing on the "Iftar to Suhoor" lifestyle. | Daily posts/Stories |

---

**Action Items:**
*   **Omar Haddad:** Please provide the visual assets for the landing page and social media templates by Nov 10.
*   **Team:** All copy must be finalized by Nov 12.

**سارة القحطاني**
**مديرة التسويق**

### Ramadan Campaign Visual Guidelines: Qahwa Lab

**To:** Sara Al-Qahtani, Marketing Director
**From:** Omar Haddad, Brand Designer
**Date:** November 10, 2024
**Subject:** Ramadan Campaign Visual Assets & Guidelines

---

#### 1. Design Concept: "The Modern Saudi Ramadan"
The visual identity for this campaign bridges the gap between traditional Saudi heritage and the minimalist, specialty-coffee aesthetic of Qahwa Lab. 

*   **Core Aesthetic:** Warm, atmospheric lighting (reminiscent of lantern light), clean typography, and focus on the tactile experience of brewing coffee.
*   **Visual Elements:** Subtle geometric patterns inspired by Najdi architecture, textured backgrounds (linen/clay), and high-contrast photography of the "Ramadan Blend" packaging against evening settings.

#### 2. Color Palette
*   **Primary:** 
    *   **Deep Night Blue (#0B1B2B):** Represents the post-Iftar evening sky.
    *   **Warm Sand (#D4B483):** Represents the warmth of the coffee and desert heritage.
*   **Secondary:**
    *   **Roasted Bean Brown (#4A3728):** Used for text and graphic details.
    *   **Off-White (#F9F7F2):** Used for backgrounds to maintain a clean, premium look.

#### 3. Typography
*   **English:** *Montserrat* (Modern, clean, and highly legible for digital interfaces).
*   **Arabic:** *DIN Next LT Arabic* (Professional, geometric, and perfectly suited to the Qahwa Lab brand voice).

#### 4. Asset Specifications & Templates
All assets are delivered in the attached source pack (Adobe Illustrator/Photoshop files).

*   **Social Media Templates (Instagram/Snapchat):**
    *   **Format:** 1080x1920 (Stories/Snapchat) and 1080x1350 (Feed).
    *   **Structure:** Minimalist layout with a centered product shot, clear "20% OFF" badge in the corner, and the campaign code **RAMADAN20** placed prominently.
*   **Landing Page Assets:**
    *   **Hero Banner:** High-resolution lifestyle image (Iftar setting).
    *   **Icons:** Custom line-art icons for "Free Delivery" and "Specialty Roast" features.
    *   **Buttons:** Rounded-corner buttons in Deep Night Blue with white typography for high conversion.

#### 5. Delivery Checklist
*   [ ] Source files (.AI, .PSD) for all social media templates.
*   [ ] Web-optimized assets for the landing page (Hero images, icon sets).
*   [ ] Brand style guide (PDF) for social media team reference.

*Note: All visual assets are ready for your review. Please confirm if any adjustments are needed for the influencer partnership content.*

Best regards,

**Omar Haddad**
Brand Designer, Qahwa Lab

# Qahwa Lab Ramadan Campaign: Visual Assets and Brand Guidelines

**To:** Sara Al-Qahtani, Marketing Director  
**From:** Omar Haddad, Brand Designer  
**Date:** November 10 (assumption)  
**Subject:** Ramadan Visual Guidelines, Color Palettes, and Source Asset Pack  

---

### 1. Overview & Aesthetic Direction

The Qahwa Lab Ramadan visual identity bridges traditional Saudi heritage with our signature modern, minimalist aesthetic. Moving away from overused clichés, our visual language relies on rich, earthy tones, subtle geometric patterns inspired by Najdi architecture, and warm lighting that captures the transition from Iftar to Suhoor.

### 2. Color Palette

*   **Primary Deep Midnight (Backgrounds/Text):** `#111827` (Represents the quiet elegance of Ramadan nights)
*   **Secondary Warm Sand (Cards/Accents):** `#F3EFEA` (Reflects modern Saudi interior design)
*   **Accent Desert Gold (Highlights/CTAs):** `#D4AF37` (Evokes premium hospitality and dates)
*   **Terracotta Roast (Brand Anchor):** `#8C4A32` (Directly connects to our signature coffee beans and clay pottery)

### 3. Typography Hierarchy

*   **Arabic Display & Headings:** Tajawal (Bold/Extra Bold) – Clean, modern, highly legible for digital campaigns.
*   **English Display & Headings:** Montserrat (Semi-Bold/Bold) – Geometric sans-serif matching our core brand guidelines.
*   **Body Copy:** Inter (Regular/Medium) for optimal readability across mobile landing pages and emails.

---

### 4. Source Asset Pack Delivery

The complete source file package (`Qahwa_Lab_Ramadan_Visual_Assets_2024.zip`) has been organized and uploaded to our shared design repository (assumption). 

**Package Contents:**
1.  **`/Vector_Sources/` (.AI, .EPS):** 
    *   Master vector files for brand patterns, crescent-and-cup iconography, and lockups incorporating the "RAMADAN20" promo code.
2.  **`/Social_Templates/` (.PSD, .FIG):**
    *   **Instagram Reels / Snapchat vertical templates (9:16):** Configured for lifestyle shots, product reveals, and influencer unboxing frames.
    *   **Instagram Carousel / Post templates (1:1 / 4:5):** Optimized for the "Iftar to Suhoor" lifestyle narrative and the 20% discount announcement.
3.  **`/Landing_Page_Assets/` (.FIG, .SVG):**
    *   Hero section banner graphics, product badge overlays ("Proudly Roasted in Riyadh"), and localized bilingual UI buttons.
4.  **`/Brand_Guidelines/` (.PDF):**
    *   The complete 12-page PDF document detailing clear space rules, typography pairing, and color usage for the Ramadan campaign.

*(Note: As source files require direct digital transfer, please access the `/Design-Team/Ramadan-2024/` folder on our internal server to download the active source pack.)*

---

**Omar Haddad**  
**Brand Designer**

e4706d5dc27c596a786824467021def3b6ff0b04.text:
**To:** Sara Al-Qahtani, Marketing Director  
**From:** Omar Haddad, Brand Designer  
**Date:** November 10, 2025  
**Subject:** Ramadan-Themed Visual Guidelines and Asset Specifications – Qahwa Lab Campaign  

---

### **1. Introduction**
This document outlines the complete visual identity, color palettes, typography, and graphic templates for the upcoming Qahwa Lab Ramadan campaign. Designed to blend modern specialty coffee aesthetics with authentic Saudi Ramadan heritage, these guidelines ensure a cohesive visual experience across our bilingual landing page, social media channels, and email sequence.

---

### **2. Color Palette**
Our color system balances the deep, rich tones of specialty coffee with warm, celebratory hues reflecting Saudi Ramadan evenings—moving gracefully from Iftar warmth to Suhoor calm.

*   **Primary Dark Roast (Deep Coffee Brown):** `#1A110B`  
    *Usage:* Primary text, dark backgrounds, high-contrast framing.
*   **Secondary Warm Sand (Desert Dunes):** `#E5C596`  
    *Usage:* Secondary backgrounds, framing lines, subtle text accents.
*   **Accent Metallic Gold (Ramadan Elegance):** `#D4AF37`  
    *Usage:* Call-to-action buttons, discount badges (**RAMADAN20**), key highlight text.
*   **Heritage Emerald (Saudi Palm & Tradition):** `#113225`  
    *Usage:* Secondary accent blocks, badge backgrounds, seasonal thematic highlights.
*   **Background Cream (Modern Minimal):** `#F9F6F0`  
    *Usage:* Main canvas background for landing page and clean social posts.

---

### **3. Typography & Calligraphy Guidelines**
Typography must remain sharp, modern, and easily readable on mobile devices while maintaining a warm, welcoming tone.

*   **English Primary Font:** *Montserrat* (Weights: Bold for headings, Regular for body copy). Clean, geometric, and modern.
*   **Arabic Primary Font:** *Cairo* or *Tajawal* (Weights: Bold for headings, Medium for body copy). Highly optimized for digital screens and modern Saudi brand aesthetics.
*   **Calligraphic Element:** A minimal, modern custom script styling for the campaign headline ("ارتقِ بأمسياتك الرمضانية") positioned as a subtle background watermark or header accent. Avoid overly ornate traditional calligraphy to maintain Qahwa Lab's modern brand voice.

---

### **4. Visual Motifs & Imagery Style**
*   **Photography Direction:** Warm, moody lighting simulating late afternoon/dusk through to pre-dawn. Focus on close-up shots of brewing Qahwa (poured from a traditional *Dallah* into modern ceramic cups), textured packaging of the Ramadan Blend, and atmospheric home settings in Riyadh.
*   **Graphic Patterns:** Subtle, minimalist geometric patterns inspired by Najdi architectural heritage integrated with abstract coffee bean contours. Use thin gold or sand-colored lines at 15% opacity to border social media templates.

---

### **5. Graphic Template Specifications**

#### **A. Social Media: Instagram Feed (1080 x 1080 px)**
*   **Layout:** Cream background (`#F9F6F0`), centered product shot of the Ramadan Blend bag with a soft gold drop shadow.
*   **Text Placement:** Top-left alignment for bilingual copy. English headline in `#1A110B`, Arabic subtitle in `#113225`.
*   **Offer Badge:** Bottom-right circular badge in Metallic Gold (`#D4AF37`) with dark brown text reading "20% OFF — Code: RAMADAN20".

#### **B. Social Media: Instagram Stories & Snapchat Ads (1080 x 1920 px)**
*   **Layout:** Vertical split-screen. Top 60% features a looping video of Qahwa pouring (Iftar mood); bottom 40% solid Deep Roast (`#1A110B`) background.
*   **Text Placement:** Centered in the bottom dark block. White and gold typography highlighting the "Free delivery after Iftar" offer.
*   **Interactive Element:** "Swipe Up" / "Shop Now" button styled in Metallic Gold with dark brown bold text.

#### **C. Landing Page Hero Banner (1920 x 1080 px)**
*   **Layout:** Full-width lifestyle banner featuring a modern Riyadh living room setup during Ramadan nights, featuring a steaming cup of coffee and a subtle crescent moon graphic integration.
*   **Text Overlay:** Left-aligned text box with semi-transparent dark overlay for maximum contrast.
*   **CTA Button:** Prominent "Buy Now" button in `#D4AF37` linking directly to the Ramadan Blend checkout.

---

### **6. Source File Handoff Structure**
The complete asset package is prepared in source formats (.AI for vector assets, .PSD for raster templates, and .FIG for Figma landing page components) and is structured in the local project directory as follows:
*   `/01_Brand_Guidelines/` (PDF guidelines and color swatches)
*   `/02_Social_Media_Templates/` (Instagram and Snapchat source files)
*   `/03_Landing_Page_Assets/` (Hero banners, product cards, and icon sets)

*The design files are maintained in the local design repository and are ready for the development and marketing teams to implement ahead of the November 20 launch.*

**Omar Haddad**  
**Brand Designer**

المُرسل: سارة القحطاني (مديرة التسويق)

فريق المشروع: سارة القحطاني (مديرة التسويق)، عمر حداد (مصمم الهوية)

الحالة: مسودة خطة الإطلاق

هدف الحملة

إطلاق حملة شهر رمضان المبارك لعلامة القهوة المختصة "مختبر القهوة" (Qahwa Lab) بحلول تاريخ 20 نوفمبر. تشمل الحملة صفحة هبوط ثنائية اللغة، سلسلة رسائل بريدية للإطلاق، وخطة وسائل تواصل اجتماعي لمدة أسبوعين.

معلومات السياق والهوية

  • يدير مختبر القهوة 6 مقاهٍ في الرياض ويبيع حبوب القهوة عبر الإنترنت.
  • عرض رمضان: خصم 20% على مزيج رمضان وتوصيل مجاني بعد الإفطار.
  • صوت العلامة التجارية: دافئ، عصري، وبفخر سعودي.
  • ميزانية الوسائط: 40,000 ريال سعودي (افتراضية/تقديرية لتنفيذ الحملة).

مهام إطلاق الحملة

  • صفحة الهبوط: جاهزة ومتاحة للوصول (تتطلب استضافة وتأكيد من الشخص المسؤول عن التقنية).
  • البريد الإلكتروني: جدولة سلسلة الرسائل البريدية في أدوات التسويق.
  • وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي: جدولة منشورات خطة الأسبوعين في أدوات النشر.
